PREFACE 
 
 
 
It gives me immense pleasure in releasing “Crime 
Review - Tamil Nadu – 2017” which is being published 
annually by the State Crime Records Bureau, Tamil Nadu 
based on the pattern of “Crime in India” published by the 
National Crime Records Bureau, New Delhi. 
  
The contents of the Crime Review have been prepared 
for the use by all the members of the Police force as well as 
Legislators, Academicians and fellow researchers.   
 
It contains detailed information about incidences of 
crimes, road accidents etc. in Tamil Nadu. The report is 
being published in two volumes as Crime Review Tamil 
Nadu – 2017 (Statistics) and Crime Review Tamil Nadu - 
2017 (Compendium).  
 
I would like to compliment the hard work put in by 
all the officers of the State Crime Records Bureau 
associated with the preparation of this review and for 
making it as comprehensive, meaningful and interesting as 
possible. 
 
 
 
 
             
(T. K. RAJENDRAN, IPS) 
Director General of Police, 
Tamil Nadu.
